digest.component_or_area: completion-verification close gate / LLM agent runaway guard + memo composition
propositions: The runaway guard observes tool calls BEFORE the memo layer serves them, so memo-cached repeats (free, harmless) are still counted as loop evidence and trip RunawayToolLoopError despite the memoization fix.

Guard and memo layers fight each other: lever 2 made repeats cheap; the guard still punishes them as loop evidence, causing legitimate completion-verification closes to abort and fall back to --force.

The guard must recompose with the memo layer via a shared ToolCallLedger that records only EXECUTED work (calls that miss cache), not served calls, so the distinct-ratio arm evaluates only real tool invocations.
A served-streak backstop arm must still bound pure cache-served loops (zero execution for a full window) after the memo-only ratio fix, to prevent infinite model re-reads of cached data.

Five execution-recording sites in the memo layer must be instrumented (non-allowlisted passthrough, exact-signature cache miss, unparseable read_file path, first-read whole-file fetch, truncated-window fallback) to properly report executed work to the shared ledger.

Layer order must remain Guard→Memo→Steering with completion policy between them, and memo-served repeats must not reset the served-streak counter, allowing the backstop to detect genuine cache loops while the ratio arm ignores memoization chatter.
